cpqBml.connection.enabled.description: Enable Oracle CPQ REST features. If disabled, settings onboarding will be suppressed and all REST toolbar icons will be hidden from the editor title bar.

cpqBml.connection.siteUrl.markdownDescription: Your Oracle CPQ instance. Accepts a bare sitename, host, or full URL. Or open the custom settings dashboard: [Open Settings Webview](command:cpqBml.settings.open?%5B%22connection%22%5D)

cpqBml.connection.authMethod.description: Authentication method for CPQ REST calls: 'basic' (username/password) or 'bearer' (an OAuth/SAML token you already have).

cpqBml.connection.username.description: Username for Basic authentication. The password/token itself is never stored here - use the 'CPQ-BML: Set CPQ Password' / 'Set CPQ Auth Token' commands, which store it securely via VS Code Secret Storage.

cpqBml.connection.environments.markdownDescription: Configure multiple CPQ environments to switch between them quickly. Or manage them in the custom settings dashboard: [Open Settings Webview](command:cpqBml.settings.open?%5B%22environments%22%5D),

name.description: The custom name of the environment (e.g. dev, test, prod).

siteUrl.description: The URL of the CPQ instance (e.g. sitename or sitename.bigmachines.com).

cpqBml.rest.restVersion.description: Oracle CPQ REST API version segment used when building request paths, e.g. v18 -> /rest/v18/bml/library/functions.

cpqBml.rest.commerceProcess.description: Commerce Process variable name used for commerce BML REST operations.

cpqBml.rest.commerceDocument.description: Commerce Process document variable name used by 'CPQ-BML: Pull Commerce Functions from CPQ' (e.g. 'transaction'). Change this if your commerce process functions live under a different document.

cpqBml.rest.productFamily.description: Product Family variable name used for configuration operations and attribute sync (e.g. 'servers', 'telecom'). Leave blank or set to '_allProductFamilies' to discover and sync all product families.

cpqBml.features.lint.description: Enable BML linting (diagnostics and quick fixes). Individual lines or whole files can still be excluded with // bml-lint-disable comments regardless of this setting.

cpqBml.features.codeLens.description: Enable BML CodeLens action links (Debug on Cloud, Diff with Server, Run BMQL Live) directly above functions and query blocks.

cpqBml.features.comments.description: Enable BML Better Comments: colorizes tagged comments (TODO/FIXME/!/?/* etc), highlights functional directive comments (// bml-lint-disable*, /* beautify ignore:start/end */) distinctly, and styles docHeader comment blocks (Function Name/Description/Inputs/Return).

cpqBml.features.spelling.description: Enable BML & CPQ domain spelling checker for BML keywords, built-ins, and CPQ terminology (generic English prose is handled by Code Spell Checker).

cpqBml.spelling.userWords.description: Custom words to ignore during BML spelling checks.

cpqBml.features.beautifier.description: Enable BML code formatting / beautification support.

cpqBml.features.intellisense.description: Enable BML autocomplete, hover, signature help, go-to-definition, find references, rename, and document symbols.

cpqBml.inlayHints.enabled.description: Enable inline parameter name inlay hints for BML function calls.

cpqBml.inlayHints.suppressWhenArgumentMa.description: Suppress inlay hints when the passed argument matches the parameter name (e.g. avoid showing redundant 'record: record').

cpqBml.inlayHints.minimumParameters.description: Minimum number of parameters a function must accept before inlay hints are shown.

cpqBml.features.docHeader.description: Enable BML automatic doc-header completion (triggered by typing '///').

cpqBml.features.testing.description: Enable BML unit test runner and snapshot testing.

cpqBml.mcp.enable.description: Start a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server so an AI agent (e.g. Claude Code) can call CPQ-BML's pull/save/validate/debug/deploy operations directly. The server only binds to 127.0.0.1 (this machine only) and never exposes your CPQ credentials to the connecting client - only the extension itself builds the Authorization header. Run 'CPQ-BML: Show MCP Server Connection Info' for the connection URL.

cpqBml.mcp.port.description: Localhost port the MCP server listens on, when cpqBml.mcp.enable is true.

cpqBml.mcp.logToTerminal.description: When enabled, every MCP tool call (list/pull/save/validate/debug/deploy/create) streams its progress into a dedicated 'CPQ-BML (AI)' integrated terminal, so you can watch what an AI agent is doing to your CPQ instance in real time. Off by default; the same log is always included in each tool's result regardless of this setting.

cpqBml.debug.logRestDetails.description: Log CPQ REST request/response details to a local 'bml_rest_api.log' file in the workspace root.

cpqBml.debug.logOutputToFile.description: When enabled, saves debug output to two files in the workspace root after each BML debug run: 'bml_debug_output.log' (script return value) and 'bml_debug_print.log' (print statements). Disabled by default.

cpqBml.debug.showResultsAsTable.description: When enabled, formats JSON or dictionary return values in BML debug output as a key-value table. Disabled by default.

cpqBml.debug.concurrency.description: Number of transactions to debug simultaneously in parallel (min 2, max 10). Default is 2.

cpqBml.debug.smartReuseInputs.description: Smart Debug: Automatically reuse previous transaction ID(s) and parameter inputs on repeated debug runs without prompting. Use 'CPQ-BML: Debug Current Function (Configure New Inputs / Transaction...)' or hold Alt while clicking Debug to change inputs.

scripts.generate:docs: npm run crawl:docs && npm run generate:intellisense
